filed: 2026-11-22, definition-lead (writer agent), before any GPU run of this experiment
descriptive: user via writeup-lead, 2026-11-22 (cell P2.64): 'read all at once', against matched randoms, base prior as a confound; aim (a): 'if we can detect reuse/new on realistic fine-tunes'. No verdict under the frozen definition is given here: the run reports E_b over K per side; no rule turns it into reuse or new

settings.seeds_source: every seed E211 saved at the scored size (experiments/realistic_tasks/results/run2_<task>.json states s<seed>_<size>). Scored size only, as E246 (experiments/realtext_proxies/run.py SIZE): at the smaller sizes the coin label is reached before it is learnt (label-word gain 0.14-0.21) and French gains under the floor (reports/analyses/2026-11-18_analysis_realistic-tasks-run2.md), so those states read nothing the scored ones do not, and every saved cheap reading (E246's r, S) is at the scored size
settings.label_pos_source: the label rows' last position, E211's read (run2_L1.json read.pos 34) and E246's (pod0.json prior.L1.pos 34); D is the 35-token rows whole
settings.text_pos_source: E211's read position (predictions_run2.json settings half 63; run2_T1.json read.pos 63), E246's (prior.T*.pos 63). D is each 127-token window cut after position 63: the model is causal, so the argmax at 63 and every interchange on it are unchanged by the later tokens, and E_b's write pass sums over the 64 positions up to the read, as E268's 64-token D did. One read position, not all 64: every saved cheap reading of these states read this one, and E268's all-position reads cost 2.8x its last-position ones (1,442 s against 511 s per item, experiments/kstar_needed/results/items/x2.json, random_kl_241002.json)
settings.e268_source: derangements, examples, rows, logit_rows, cache_batch, ident_vars: E268's settings (experiments/kstar_needed/results/predictions.json), so K samples the same 256 pairs per item as E268's and E_b over K on the matched randoms can be set beside E268's randoms (0.0089-0.0130); rows and logit_rows are memory only
settings.seed_source: the derangements' seed, fixed (the cell's number, P2.64); one seed for every item, so the sides of a pair that share D (L1, L3) are read on the same pairs, and each fine-tune and its random too
settings.featurization_source: E226's split_tol (experiments/kstar_vpd/results/predictions.json settings) and its per-matrix featurization guards (thresholds split_fp64_tol, F_from_pieces_tol, M_from_pieces_tol), as every E_b item read since E226
settings.random_size_rel_tol_source: the random repeats E246's draw: the same function (commute.finetune.random_direction) on the same saved state with the same seed, so its size (commute.realistic.update_size) should equal E246's saved random size to the last bit; E246's own random against its state differs by 6e-12 relative (pod0.json label/L1_s0: 0.010003241340049254 against 0.010003241339988667), so 1e-9 is missed only by a different draw or a different state

readings.K: the variables (subcomponents and remainders of the 24 decomposed matrices; the embedding and unembedding are the input and output variables, not tested) for which some tested pair (x, x') of D changes F's argmax token at the read position when the variable's write on x is replaced by its write in F's own run on x' (commute.needed.needed_set: 4 seeded derangements x 64 windows = 256 pairs). A sample: the K read is a subset of the definition's K; by_derangement shows its growth with pairs. Blind to variables needed only on untested pairs. Positive control: none that knows K in advance; the identity interchange must change nothing
readings.E_b_K: commute.stand_in.explained_share(num, den, dd, K and changed): over K's changed members, the share of each one's write change on D that M's own write at its non-negative least-squares gain explains, weighted by write change (option (b), decisions.md 2026-11-21). 1 when K has no changed member (degenerate, flagged). Blind to how much each variable matters for the behaviour (it weighs by write change), and to unchanged members of K
readings.min_margin, n_fragile_positions: F's smallest top-1 minus top-2 logit gap over D's read positions, and the positions whose gap is at most stage 0's identity deviation (where fp32 rounding alone could move the argmax)
readings.saved, beside (summary stage, not recomp: E211's share in log-odds (run2_<task>.json share.share.lo), E246's log-odds share r and S for the fine-tune and its random (realtext_proxies/results/pod*.json own, random), and M's prior per task (E246's geometric-mean P(scored token) at W0). The prior is reported as a confound, not as a reading: it is a property of the task under M, the same for every update on it

rules.R0a: Stage 0 stops the job on any argmax change under the identity interchange (x' = x) on L1_s0 and T1_s0, first 64 windows, three subcomponents and the remainder of every matrix, at the read position. Its largest logit deviation is the floor, recorded, not barred: the correction is exactly zero in exact arithmetic, so the deviation is the scan path's fp32 rounding. Edge case: a tie in F's top two logits would make any rounding flip it; n_fragile_positions counts such positions per item
rules.R0b: Stage 0 stops the job unless the do-nothing (F = M) on L1's D and on T1's D has no changed variable, every dd exactly 0.0 and E_b over K exactly 1.0 (K and changed is empty for any K, so the convention gives 1 with no division)
rules.R0c: Each item stops the job when its state file's sha256 is not E211's record, when its random's size is off E246's saved random size by more than random_size_rel_tol relative, or when a matrix's featurization check exceeds E226's tolerance
rules.items: descriptive, no rule. Edge cases checked: K and changed empty gives E_b 1 by convention and degenerate true (as E268's p256/addition_rl_s0), drawn apart in the figure and never pooled; K empty likewise; a random update changes every variable, so on it K and changed is K; n_changed_K = 0 with size_K > 0 (only unchanged variables needed) is also degenerate. The card's rivals (experiments/realtext_eb/card.md) read the sides against each other and against the matched randoms with the seed spread 0.004

expected.stage0: identity: 0 argmax changes, largest logit deviation about 5e-5 or below (E268's 5.1e-5 and 5.4e-5); do-nothing: 0 changed, dd 0.0, E_b over K 1.0 on both D; estimate about 450 s per label item and 740 s per text item on an H100 (E268: 505-514 s per 41-token item, 733-743 s per 64-token item)
expected.randoms: E_b over K about 0.009-0.013, E268's 11 matched randoms on other tasks (experiments/kstar_needed/results/summary.json); outside 0.005-0.03 is reported as a surprise, not a stop. |K| large (E268's 11 randoms: 14,400-38,935 of 38,938)
expected.fine-tunes: not filed (descriptive). The card's rival a: each pair's first side (L1, T1, T2) above its second (L3, T4, T3) by more than 0.01, both above the randoms; rival b: all six sides within the randoms' range or within 0.01 of each other. Known confound: M's prior orders French below Yoruba (E246: 1.9e-6 against 4.2e-6), against the built direction
